The Problem

You've done everything the old playbook said. It's not enough anymore.

What you see
Ads running. Clicks coming in. Phone rings sometimes.
What you don't see
Every buyer who asked ChatGPT, Perplexity, or a Google AI Overview — and got a competitor's name instead of yours.
What it's costing you
AI recommendations convert at 3–5x the rate of a Google click. They're unprompted. They feel trusted. And they go to one business per search.

You've got reviews. A website that works. You're running ads. The old playbook is checked off. But AI systems don't rank pages — they answer questions. And most local business websites don't answer specific buyer questions. They describe services.

There's a difference. AI knows the difference. Your customers are learning it.

The real problem

The conventional marketing playbook was built for the search era. The search era is ending. ChatGPT has 200 million weekly active users. Perplexity is the fastest-growing search product in history. Google AI Overviews now appear above organic results on most high-intent searches. The businesses that earn AI citations first will own their category for years. First mover advantage in AI closes fast.

The Mechanism

We reverse-engineered how AI decides who to recommend.

There are exactly four gates.

01
Citation Readiness
Can AI actually cite your content when a buyer asks a specific question? Generic service pages can't be cited. Specific, structured, buyer-question-answering content can.
02
Presence Architecture
Does your digital presence signal the authority AI looks for before recommending a business? Quality and consistency — not volume — determine this score.
03
Conversion Architecture
When AI sends a buyer to you, do you convert them? Conversion signals also influence how AI scores your credibility as a recommendation.
04
Brand Authority
Are people searching for your business by name? Named search volume is a primary AI citation signal. Zero named search means zero brand authority.

DVS™ — Demand Visibility Score — measures all four. You get a 0–100 score, a visibility profile, a head-to-head competitor comparison, and the single highest-leverage gap to close right now.
